CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gbpConnections` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `accountName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `accountId` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `accessToken` text NOT NULL,
  `refreshToken` text,
  `tokenExpiresAt` bigint DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gbpLocations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `connectionId` int NOT NULL,
  `locationId` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `locationName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `address` text,
  `phone` varchar(64),
  `websiteUrl` varchar(512),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gbpPosts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `connectionId` int NOT NULL,
  `locationId` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `locationName` varchar(255),
  `postType` enum('STANDARD','EVENT','OFFER','PRODUCT') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STANDARD',
  `summary` text NOT NULL,
  `callToActionType` varchar(64),
  `callToActionUrl` varchar(512),
  `eventTitle` varchar(255),
  `eventStartDate` varchar(32),
  `eventEndDate` varchar(32),
  `imageUrl` varchar(512),
  `status` enum('draft','published','failed','scheduled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `scheduledFor` bigint DEFAULT 0,
  `publishedAt` bigint DEFAULT 0,
  `gbpPostName` varchar(512),
  `errorMessage` text,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `brandVoiceHistory` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `brandVoice` text NOT NULL,
  `source` enum('manual','ai_generated') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ads` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('google','facebook') NOT NULL,
  `adType` enum('search','display','responsive_search','image','video','carousel') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search',
  `headline1` varchar(30),
  `headline2` varchar(30),
  `headline3` varchar(30),
  `description1` varchar(90),
  `description2` varchar(90),
  `primaryText` text,
  `callToAction` varchar(64),
  `destinationUrl` varchar(512),
  `displayUrl` varchar(255),
  `campaignName` varchar(255),
  `adSetName` varchar(255),
  `targetKeywords` text,
  `targetAudience` text,
  `budget` varchar(32),
  `adStatus` enum('draft','ready','active','paused','completed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `notes` text,
  `impressions` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `clicks` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `spend` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `conversions` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `metricsUpdatedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `parentAdId` int,
  `variantLabel` varchar(32),
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
